fields.description: The app as it appears on the Meta developer dashboard.
fields.label: Meta App

fields.description: A name to recognise the app in lists. It changes nothing.
fields.label: App Name

fields.description: The App ID from the Meta dashboard. It is not secret.
fields.label: App ID

fields.description: The App Secret from the Meta dashboard. Without it, a pasted Graph API Explorer token stops working within the hour.
fields.label: App Secret

fields.description: The one Facebook token. Refresh From Facebook gives each Page its own token from it.
fields.label: Connection

fields.description: A system user token, which never expires, or a Graph API Explorer token, which is swapped for a 60-day one on save.
fields.label: Access Token

fields.description: The date this token stops working, filled in on save. Blank means it never expires.
fields.label: Token Expires On

fields.description: Settings for every call made through this app.
fields.label: Facebook Graph API

fields.description: The Meta API version this app uses. An outdated version quietly returns no leads, so change one app at a time.
fields.label: Graph API Version

fields.description: How many leads each call to Meta returns. It never limits the total collected.
fields.label: Leads Fetched Per Request
